camel_example: aliyun dataworks-public UpdateMcpServer --region cn-hangzhou --Visibility TENANT --VisibilityScope '{"ProjectIds":["3162"],"UserIds":["123"]}' --Transport SSE --Url 'https://example.com/mcp/sse' --CustomHeaders '{}' --Name 'my-mcp-server'
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public update-mcp-server --name my-mcp-server --url https://example.com/mcp/sse --transport SSE --visibility TENANT --visibility-scope '{"ProjectIds":["3162"],"UserIds":["123"]}' --api-version 2024-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateMcpServer

parameters.help_en: The name of the MCP Server to update
parameters.help_zh: 要更新的 MCP Server 名称
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The new service address. The address must start with`https://`
parameters.help_zh: 新的服务地址，需以 `https://` 开头
parameters.name: url

parameters.help_en: The new custom request headers, specified as key-value pairs
parameters.help_zh: 新的自定义请求头（键值对）
parameters.name: custom_headers

fields.help_en: The list of workspace IDs that can access the MCP Server. This parameter takes effect only when `Visibility` is set to `PROJECT`
fields.help_zh: 可见的项目 ID 列表，Visibility 为 \`PROJECT\` 时生效
fields.name: project_ids

fields.help_en: The list of user IDs that can access the MCP Server. This parameter takes effect only when `Visibility` is set to `USER`
fields.help_zh: 可见的用户 ID 列表，Visibility 为 \`USER\` 时生效
fields.name: user_ids

parameters.help_en: The new visibility scope. The fields in this object depend on the value of the `Visibility` parameter
parameters.help_zh: 新的可见性范围，按 Visibility 取对应字段
parameters.name: visibility_scope
